title: Unit-test the PersistFence on_acknowledged contract, and stop generic fake-ACK test persisters from publishing causal cards
outcome: Unit-test the PersistFence on_acknowledged contract, and stop generic fake-ACK test persisters from publishing causal cards
acceptance: Focused tests in src/tests/persist_fence.rs show, with a counting hook, that on_acknowledged runs exactly once and only when that call records Ok, never after Deadline (including a late finish(Ok) after the deadline), abandon, Drop, Shutdown or WorkerStopped, and that it runs after the completion mutex is released; resolve_at reports true only for the call that recorded Ok.
Generic fake-ACK test persisters (ScriptedPersister, engram_post_receipt's) no longer fake-ACK EngramCausalCard fences, or each such test states why a non-durable publication is acceptable there.
